description: Change a saved view in place: new source, title, spec_version or state. Pass only what changes. The artifact_id, its brain object and any share link stay the same.

artifact_id.description: An artifact_id from generate_view or list_artifacts.

source.description: The whole view in the view language, one statement per line.

spec_version.description: The view library version the source was written against.

state.description: The view's saved state values, keyed by name.

name: update_view
title: Update view
